essence: The agent both manifests and accomplishes worlds endowed with powers.
The sky is described as the threefold path because of the Gaṅgā's course.
She is called Kāmarūpā because that is her form.
The remainder means it is attainable by those who desire enjoyment.
The eightfold division is understood as the forms of aṇimā and the rest.
